posts.title: Your dev computer, from your phone | Pocket Dev
posts.caption:
We built Pocket Dev because we wanted to spend less time tied to a desk without losing touch with our work.

Claude Code, Codex, terminals, Git and files — from your phone’s browser, running on your own computer.

Free and open source. No phone app or Pocket Dev cloud account needed. Your computer must stay on and awake. Access away from the same Wi-Fi needs optional setup.

The video shows a demo project with scripted agent responses.

Explore Pocket Dev: theani.me/work/pocket-dev
AI setup prompts: theani.me/work/pocket-dev/prompts
Source: github.com/anisirji/pocket-dev

If it makes your day a little freer, share it with three people you’d love to see escape the PC cage too. No pressure. ❤️

Project updates: @afk_pocket_dev
